elements.text: Choose which card payment provider takes card payments from a checkout. Use the target finder at the top to pick where this applies: the tenant, a group, a store or a single checkout. A value set higher up applies to every checkout below it, unless a checkout has its own.
A checkout can use only one provider at a time. Card terminals that run through an app on the checkout (Adyen local) do not use this page: they are chosen on the tender.
Next step: enter your Adyen account once under “Payments – Adyen cloud account”, then register each checkout's terminal under “Payments – Adyen cloud terminals”.
Next step: the Worldline Terminal API account and terminals are set up in the Worldline connector configuration app.
Next step: this provider's account and terminals are not on this portal yet. Use the older Hii Connect payment configuration app.
Card payments from this checkout will not be sent through Hii Connect.
NONE: no cloud card provider. Use it for checkouts without card payments, or with a terminal that runs through an app on the checkout.
ADYEN_CLOUD: Adyen terminals reached through Adyen's cloud. Needs an Adyen account and a terminal ID per checkout.
NETS_CLOUD: Nets (Nexi) card terminals reached through the cloud.
SOFTPAY: Softpay, for card payments with tap to pay on a phone or tablet.
WOTAPI: Worldline terminals through the Worldline Terminal API.
